equations: theta'=1, r'=(1-r^2)r; equivalent Cartesian polynomial system
interpretation: Deterministic exact-solution benchmark. Radius and phase accuracy are separate from finite sampled boundedness. This dissipative state-space oscillator is not a mass-conserving physical water model. No empirical data, mesh, random seeds or new biological force.
screenshot_corrections: r0=0 stays at the origin, where polar angle is undefined; r0=1 is an invariant rotating circle. For r>1 the separated integral needs log(abs(1-r^2)), although the final initial-value formula is valid forward for all r0>0.
